name: Michael - Soft and Calm
description:
An Irish soft male voice melodic and soothing, with a gentle lilt that carries a sense of warmth and friendliness  that can be both engaging and comforting to listeners.

Michael is has a natural, storytelling charm, making the narrative feel more intimate and immersive. It can convey a range of emotions subtly, from the soft-spoken tenderness of a heartfelt moment to the quiet intensity of a suspenseful scene.

description: A calm, conversational Irish voice suited to long-form narration and audiobooks. Reflective, steady and clear, with a quiet authority that feels human rather than performed. Ideal for storytelling and content that values depth, presence and trust.

name: Peter - Clear, Expressive and Warm
description: A Young male from Northern Ireland, with a calm relaxing and warm tone. Perfect voice for narration, tutorials or podcast readings. Very clear Northern Irish voice with a slight irish accent. Smooth and moderately paced, ideal for instructional and conversational purposes. Professional tone with a balanced pitch, making it versatile for both casual and formal settings.

name: Maeve - Soft Irish female
description: Maeve is a soft, warm Irish female voice designed for storytelling, audiobooks, and comforting narration. With a gentle Irish accent and natural melodic flow, this voice is ideal for bedtime stories, folklore,  podcasts, and immersive audio experiences. Calm, expressive, and reassuring, Maeve brings warmth and authentic Irish charm to every story, making listeners feel safe, welcome, and deeply engaged.

name: Laura -  Natural  & Grounded
description:
Warm, articulate Irish female voice with a fresh, modern tone. 

Expert in corporate training, onboarding, and healthcare messaging. 

My voice offers calm authority for wellness and meditations, yet brings a natural, engaging energy to storytelling and children’s books. Ideal for explainer videos, lifestyle ads, and educational audio. 

A grounded, versatile narrator for brands and creators seeking trust, clarity, and a genuine human connection across all media.
